'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Jan Berueda LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Berueda]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jan Berueda]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
